note: Approved pixel areas for in-flight, unmerged changes only (ADR-0001 ruling, 2026-10-17): boxes approve PIXELS only, every DOM/string difference fails. An entry is removed once its change is in a baseline. F6 (round-chamfer-dropdown: [data-mode=round], #edgeToolMenu, sheet-radius-menu #sheet p.subtle) was removed when perf-baseline-release-3.0-6892eb7 (a full render of 6892eb7) became the baseline. Format: {baseline: <baseline folder name>, box: <selector>, overlay: <selector|null>, scenes: {<scene>: [<selector>...]}}; pixels.mjs applies it only when basename(AVALON_PIXEL_BASELINE) equals baseline. DOM entries (ADR-0001 approved-dom-areas): "dom" is a list of {scene: scene name, capture id or "*", selector, kind: attribute name or "text", expected: the exact new value, approval: commit or ruling}. A DOM change in a capture passes only when an entry matches it exactly (scene, element matches selector, same kind, new value === expected); every other DOM change, every aria-label/role change without its own entry and every computed-style/box change fails. Selectors: one complex selector of tag/#id/.class/[attr=value] compounds joined by " " or ">", whose last compound has an #id, .class or [attr=value]; no "*", lists, pseudo-classes, "+"/"~", presence or partial attribute matches, or bare tags (tests/perf/approved-dom.mjs). expected must be a string in the baseline's strings-baseline.json or tests/perf/strings-additions.json (checked at load). Like the boxes, entries are for in-flight, unmerged changes only: an entry is removed when its change merges and the baseline rolls forward. This branch (inch-units, ADR-0001 F1c, on top of F1a): box = the desktop help pill #desktopHelp (F1a's approved '· ? for shortcuts'); scenes = the Edit sheet (#sheet) in edit-glyph and sheet-edit-object: the approved 'Dimensions · millimeters' header row with the mm | in switch (#dimsTitle + #unitSwitch) and the 'Position · millimeters' title (#posTitle). The switch row is taller than the old title, so everything below it in the sheet moves down; that is why the area is the whole sheet, as in the earlier --allow-box '#sheet' checks.
